description: This PHP file defines the class 'ViewModifyProperties' which extends from 'SugarView'. Its purpose is to generate and display a configuration interface for modifying connector properties within the SuiteCRM system, specifically in the administration module. It manages obtaining connector data, filtering for enabled connectors, retrieving required configuration fields, and rendering the interface using a Smarty template.

classes.name: ViewModifyProperties
classes.description: A view class for modifying connector properties in the SuiteCRM admin interface, responsible for preparing data and rendering a Smarty template with connector configuration options.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns the breadcrumb navigation links for the page as an array of HTML anchor tags with translated strings.

methods.name: _getModuleTab
methods.description: Returns the name of the module tab, here 'Administration'.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Main method to prepare data (connectors, required fields) and render the modification interface template.
